high_level_description: The image shows two individuals shaking hands in front of two European Union flags. The person on the left is wearing a white blouse and black pants, accessorized with a gold bracelet and earrings. The person on the right is dressed in a dark suit with a white shirt and a red tie featuring a dotted pattern. Both individuals appear to be smiling and engaged in a formal interaction. The background consists of two blue flags with yellow stars, which are characteristic of the European Union flag. The flags are mounted on poles with golden finials at the top.
